articleTitle: Technical Economic Analysis Concerning Connection Groups of Distribution Transformers in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In Bulgaria's electricity distribution system, there are over forty thousand power transformers in operation. This article deals with the types of connection of three phase distribution transformer windings and the behavior of the transformer under highly asymmetric loads and emergency modes in low-voltage networks. Transformers with Dyn connection are the most common in distribution networks in our country. Small group of transformers with power of up to 100 kVA are produced with Yzn connection, all other groups of transformers with power above 100 kVA are with Dyn connection. This distinction/separation is introduced due to the fact that small power transformers often operate in modes with large asymmetry of the phase loadings. The increase in loads and the inclusion of more and more non-linear loads in the networks require a change in this separation criterion. In this article, the behavior of transformers from the two main types of connection of windings under the influence of asymmetric currents and short circuits in low-voltage networks is analyzed. A techno-economic analysis of the profitability of the two main connection types under conditions of different loading has been performed and we propose a model for determination of the type of transformer connection according to the prevailing mode of operation of low voltage networks. Examples are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Analytical Model for Thermal Analysis of Toroidal Chokes and Transformers in Non-Stationary Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this article, a model for analytical description of thermal processes in electromagnetic components, in non-stationary mode, is proposed. The heating of chokes and transformers with a toroidal magnetic core is considered, as the coils and the magnetic core are described as an inhomogeneous body. For this purpose, the equations for description of the processes, as well as calculations, and comparative studies are carried out.

articleTitle: CFD Analysis of the Influence of Temperature Stratification on the Storage Capacity and Heat Loss of a Water Heat Accumulator
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The effects of stratification on the performance of a water heat accumulator and the effects of stratification on the heat loss of a water heat accumulator are investigated in a mathematical model created in a virtual computer environment using the ANSYS software product under different heat loading topologies. The heat source is a solar system for harnessing renewable energy.

articleTitle: A Proposal for a New E-Waste Image Dataset Based on the UNU-KEYS Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper introduces the largest and most diverse e-waste dataset to date, consisting of 19,613 pictures, 28,941 annotations, and 77 classes, where each class represents one visually distinctive type of electronic device. Furthermore, our dataset was structured using the United Nations University's UNU-KEYS classification, which ensures the compatibility of our dataset with the different e-waste classifications used worldwide and allowed us to choose more relevant dataset classes. The proposed methodology for image collection, annotation, and labeling is explained. The advantages and disadvantages of this dataset and how it can be improved in the future are presented. This dataset has been made open source with a permissive CC by 4.0 license so that it can be used to stimulate scientific progress in the field of automatic e-waste recognition, with the end goal of solving the global e-waste problem. The dataset is available online at https://universe.roboflow.com/electronic-waste-detection/e-waste-dataset-r0ojc.

articleTitle: Parametric Study of Thermal Processes of an Active Solar System for Indirect Heating of Water in a Water Accumulator under Simultaneous Charging and Discharging
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A computer virtual prototype of a water accumulator in parallel charging and discharging mode is developed. The heat source is a solar system for harnessing renewable energy. Analyses have been developed and dependencies have been identified with application in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Simulations of Control Algorithms in Intelligent Substations
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Modern distribution networks are in a stage of transformation. The first type of transformation is in terms of their transition to grids with available distributed sources of electricity, the other one consists in changing the load profile of the connected consumers of electricity. The transformations lead to a widening of the range of voltage deviations and changes in the reactive loads. The effective control of the voltage variation within acceptable limits requires new approaches and technical solutions. Smart substations and the formation of smart grids are the trends to address these and other problems in energy systems. In this paper, a distribution network model is developed that can be used to simulate variable operating modes of both loads and power sources. An algorithm for centralized voltage regulation in an exemplary network has been developed and implemented.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Tension of the MGU Casing on Its Dynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article examined and assessed the parts of traction motor-gear units (referred to as MGUs) and their components within suburban-type electric multiple units (EMUs) subject to vibrational strength analysis. It was found that the bearing shields of the MGUs are the most heavily loaded and worn parts. By measuring the vibration levels of different types of bearing shields, the maximum allowable loads and single impacts were determined. The primary emphasis was placed on investigating the potential impact of the motor's magnetic field on the vibration resilience of the MGUs. Relationships have been identified that enable the analysis of the correlation between the magnetic field waves in the air gap of an asynchronous motor, the radial magnetic force waves impacting the stator, and the bending deformation waves of the stator yoke. These relationships have been applied in multiphysics finite element analysis program to develop a prototype of the MGU. This model, grounded in the provided motor geometry, material characteristics, and the configuration of the current in the stator winding, facilitates the simultaneous exploration of interconnected electromagnetic and mechanical processes across diverse components of the electric machine. Moreover, it considers the rotor's rotation influenced by magnetic forces. The outcomes of the simulation have facilitated the assessment of the radial magnetic force's magnitude impacting the stator, as well as the form and frequency of its deformation waves, crucial for devising active methods to mitigate vibrations.

articleTitle: Bi-Static Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging Based on 5G NR Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This study addresses Bi-static Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (BISAR) concept with a 5G NR waveform. BISAR scenario with uncooperative transmitter and specially designed receiver, and flying target as helicopter is discussed. The positions of the transmitter, receiver and flying target are defined by vector kinematic equations. Mathematical models of 5G NR waveform and BISAR signal reflected from a target with complex geometry are described. Two dimensional (2-D) image reconstruction is realized by applying correlation with an emitted waveform or Fourier transform on a range direction, and Fourier transform on an azimuth direction. Simulation experimental results are provided to illustrate the correctness of mathematical models and imaging algorithms.

articleTitle: High Voltage Faults Conditions of In-House Loads of a Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Open circuit conditions which are not trivial to accurately locate can be detrimental to the operation of auxiliary equipment and in-house loads of a power station. Previously, the behaviour of the sections of auxiliary equipment and in-house loads, supplied through main and backup transformers, under influence of such faults on buses 220, 24 and 6 kV was studied. Thus, the purpose of this paper is to study these faults on 400 kV. Albeit the observed voltages' and currents' deformations and imbalances, selectivity of protection devices is not violated.

articleTitle: Conceptual Model of a Communication System Composed with Interoperable Radio Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Based on the TCP/IP network protocol suit, a conceptual model of interoperable communication radio systems is proposed. Interoperability of radio network devices is achieved through a synchronizing block, network operational centers, and communication computer network and distribution point. The structure and main functions of synchronizing blocks are described. Interoperability algorithm of unconnected radio network devices and digital message processing algorithm are also developed. Physical modeling and experiment is provided.

Author Keywords: a conceptual model of radio communication system's interoperability

articleTitle: Harmonic Distortions Generated By A Wind Turbine Park: Evaluation And Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article analyzes the impact of installing several converters in a wind generation system on the distortion of the voltage waveform on the main bus. It begins with an introduction to wind generation technologies and the converters used. It then explores the harmonics generated by wind turbines and their relationship to the need for frequency converters. Simulations show that, even with low harmonic content in isolated turbines, parallel installation can result in high harmonic distortion, especially in fragile systems.

articleTitle: A Study of Gear Faults in Pellet Mill's Electromechanical Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents research and analysis on the levels of the values of the vibration parameters of an electromechanical drive consisting of an electric motor, a reduction gearbox and a driven unit - a pellet mill. Due to increased noise levels found in the reduction gearbox, four vibrodiagnostic measurements were performed over a period of 100 days, examining the vibration velocity, acceleration and acceleration enveloping values. For this purpose, specific control- measurement points located on the gearbox housing have been selected in advance. The results of the measurements are presented by spectrograms. Graphical dependencies were also obtained for the deviation of the root mean square values of vibration velocity, acceleration and acceleration enveloping over time. After analyzing the obtained results and conducting an additional visual examination, a defect was found and proven on the surface of the teeth of the driven gear wheel.

articleTitle: Magnetic-Geared Bearingless Motor Unit with Central Exterior Output
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel design concept for a magnetically geared motor, where the high-speed shaft of a magnetic gear is levitated and driven by two bearingless motors. This enables high input speeds and, thus, a device with high power density. As a magnetic gear can realize high gear ratios within one stage, the motor speed can be transformed to a reasonable output speed. Besides a discussion of the proposed concept, the design aspects of the bearingless motor(s), the magnetic gear, and their interaction on a system level are presented. Also, finite-element based optimizations of the components will be conducted.

articleTitle: EEG Data Processing with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) has emerged as a powerful tool for monitoring and understanding brain activity. In recent years, the use of machine learning techniques has significantly enhanced the analysis of EEG data, offering valuable insights into neurological conditions, cognitive processes, and mental states. This paper presents a series of experiments where various machine learning techniques were used for processing real EEG data at different stages of the pipeline. To test the data obtained during visual stimulation session with human subjects, Independent Component Analysis, clustering and autoencoders were the chosen techniques. Analysis and evaluation of tested methods is provided.

articleTitle: Development of Inductively Coupled Plasma Torch 500 kW for Hydrogen Sulfide Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article presents the results of the development of an inductively coupled plasma torch with a metal split water-cooled chamber with a power of 500 kW and a frequency of 440 kHz for plasma technology of hydrogen sulfide decomposition. The design of the plasma torch is presented, the results of calculation of the water cooling of the plasma torch chamber section as well as the results of calculation of plasma processes are shown. The technology of hydrogen sulfide decomposition can be in demand as a source of hydrogen for hydrogen energy.

articleTitle: A Simplified Mathematical Model of an Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper considers the development and solution of a simplified mathematical model of an induction motor. The mathematical model describes the transient and steady-state modes of operation. This is achieved by using a system of three differential equations worked out regarding the space vectors of the variables. The results are compared with results from a mathematical model of an induction motor based on the reference frame theory. The results obtained from the two models coincide.

articleTitle: Modeling of Electric Field of Nanostructured Coatings for Electrical Impedance Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this study, the electric field modeling of nanostructured coatings for electrical impedance estimation is presented. Tungsten and tungsten nitride coatings with variable thicknesses deposited over a copper conductor are modeled. Electric field have been simulated using a 3D Finite Element Method model. Results for electrical impedance have been obtained and estimated at various thicknesses of tungsten and tungsten nitride coatings.

articleTitle: Research of Multipart Structures Based on Magnetoelectric Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of structures based on magnetoelectric materials designed to create an improved sensing element that can be used in sensors of physical quantities. Magnetoelectric are materials in which two or more types of ordering coexist simultaneously, in particular, ferromagnetic and ferroelectric. These materials have wide prospects for application in sensor technology, for example, in the creation of magnetic field sensors, magnetometers, current sensors and position sensors. The method of increasing the sensitivity of magnetoelectric elements through the use of a multipart structure is considered in the paper.

articleTitle: A Method of Intuitionistic Fuzzy Evaluation of Self Organizing Map Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper a method of Intuitionistic fuzzy evaluation of Self Organizing Map neural network is presented. The Self Organizing Map neural network is unsupervised neural networks which means that each neuron of the network represents a cluster which represents the group of data. It is described that each cluster is the representative sample of the input data and the method of intuitionistic fuzzy evaluation of the clusters is applied to the algorithm. The cluster is divided into regions and all of the data of the cluster is evaluated with intuitionistic fuzzy values (µ, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$v$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pi$</tex>) based on the region where the data point is. The use of intuitionistic fuzzy values could help us for better performance of the Self Organizing Map neural network.

articleTitle: Investigating the Probability Density Function of the Nodal Voltage Deviations in a Low-Voltage Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper investigates the probability density functions (PDFs) of the voltage deviations at the nodes of a low-voltage grid. The PDFs are obtained using a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm developed by the author and applied to a real low-voltage distribution network (LVDN). Multiple scenarios for different new power allocations are simulated. For each scenario, the whole year is simulated hourly, and the voltage deviations at the nodes are stored. The influence of the number of simulated years and the amount of new power on the resulting voltage deviation PDFs is analyzed.

articleTitle: Online Inductance Identification Using Extended Kalman Filter for Adaptive Vector Control of Synchronous Reluctance Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This study presents an adaptive vector control method for reducing the inductance sensitivity of synchronous reluctance machine drives. In the proposed control structure, the direct and quadrature inductances are identified online by using an extended Kalman filter. Therefore, only the stator resistance of the machine parameters needs to be pre-identified during the installation process. Since variations in inductances can be tracked by the estimator, the proposed adaptive vector control is able to outperform the conventional field-oriented control in cases of inductance uncertainties, as shown by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of the Power Required for Laser Cutting of Different Materials in Laboratory Conditions for Student Training
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Some of the cutting capabilities of a CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>laser machine, which is used for training students in the field of electrical technology, have been determined experimentally. A comparison was made between the laser processing of different materials with different thicknesses and different combinations of cutting parameters - power and cutting speed. Results were obtained for cutting efficiency with a specific laser machine with varying parameters of the processed materials in a relatively narrow range of setting of the machine under study.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Communication Channels Reliability for Exchanging of Hydrometeorological Information in Shipping
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The theme of the current paper is related to the need for more accurate information about the hydro meteorological conditions, as well as more <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">re</sup>liabl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup> transmission/reception in order to reduce the risk for human life in shipping and financial losses for companies in the shipping industry.

articleTitle: Multistep Model of Data Processing in Smart Classroom
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper explores the processes within a smart classroom, conceptualized as a cyber-physical social system. It systematically models the basic elements of the training space and their interactions, with a particular focus on data-handling processes. The proposed model serves as a fundamental framework for studying and building an educational cyber-physical social system.

articleTitle: Study of Induction Motor Considering the Main Flux Saturation Effect and Iron Losses
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper develops a new model, based on a nonlinear magnetic circuit model of the machine. The main flux saturation effect and the iron losses in the induction motor are accounted for by using an accurate technique. Several results are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Control Strategies for a Converter-Switched Reluctance Motor System in Motoring Mode Using Bipolar Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A comparative analysis is made in the article and simulation research of control strategies for 12/8 types (H55PWBKM-1844) power source- converter- switched reluctance motor(SRM) system operating in motor mode and a bipolar modulation. The individual control algorithms are compared using efficiency and torque ripple, converter and motor power losses. The effect of various input parameters on the efficiency, torque ripples, and losses of power in the converter and the motor for the selected control algorithms is studied using the MATLAB/Simulink environment. Based on the obtained simulation results, a comparative analysis is performed. The main considerations and recommendations for the most appropriate control strategy of the system using a bipolar excitation in motoring operation are derived.

articleTitle: Distribution of Mobile Phone Electric Field Intensity Inside a Child's Eyes
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This study conducts a numerical determining of the distribution of the electric field value in child's head subjected to radiation of 4G mobile phone. It is carried out by using realistic 3D child's head created in the framework of the investigation procedure. The electric field distribution is derived through numerical solutions of the electromagnetic wave propagation equation. The research highlights the electric field intensity across various eye tissues during mobile phone EM exposure. The intensity of the electric field varies with different tissues because their electromagnetic properties vary with frequency. It was observed that electric field intensity peaks when the radiation source is nearest to the face and diminishes markedly with increased distance. The highest electric field intensities are detected within the nose and skull regions, particularly in the skin, the fatty tissue., and bones.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis and Options for Construction Lightning Protection and Grounding Installations of Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The report examines the options for construction a lightning protection and grounding installation of photovoltaic systems- PVS, and through a critical approach, the technical and economic indicators of the types of protective installations and errors during their installation will be analyzed. The impact of lightning activity on the PVS will be considered. The need to eequipotential bonding and the connection of the individual grounding installations, as well as the legal requirements, will be analyzed, making the necessary recommendations and conclusions.

articleTitle: Study of LLC Resonant Converter with Multi-Transformer Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: High frequency transformers are used for the realization of electronic power converters with galvanic isolation. The magnetic cores offered by the manufacturers have limited largest dimensions. The application of multi-transformer topologies to resonant converter is investigated in this work. Variations in the implementation of the converter with single and multiple high frequency transformers are compared. Based on performed experimental tests of designed and prototyped single- and multi-transformer LLC converter prototypes, a comparison of the possibilities and peculiarities of the two implementations is made.

articleTitle: An Approach to Reorganizing ICT Services when Unbundling a Business Entity
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt is made to systematize the tasks and activities related to the definition of the necessary services in Information and Communication Technologies (ICT), in the separation of business processes into a business entity, dictated by the separation of separate business units. Emphasis is placed on the steps to separate all building blocks of the Information Platform (IP). One of the objectives is a successful separation and transition to two independent IPs, without significant interruption of the operational work of both structural units - the emerging and the one from which part of the current business processes is separated.

articleTitle: Modeling Filters for Harmonic Distortion Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper examines the modeling of harmonic distortion correction filters by the aim to study their performance. Gretz circuit models with a π-filter are shown, including a circuit with a third harmonic filter and a seven-diode circuit. The filters were synthesized in the Matlab/Simulink development environment.

articleTitle: Application of Radar Observation on Improvement of Buoyage System in Bulgarian Teritorial Waters
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Aids to navigation play a critical role in ensuring the safety of shipping in coastal areas, traffic separation schemes, fairways and approaches to ports. Originally designed as shore-based or floating facilities aimed at supporting visual means of navigation and later, radar observation, nowadays they are high-tech facilities based on the use of the achievements of information and communication technologies, renewable energy sources and waste-free technologies. This allows them to be easily integrated into vessel traffic management and information systems (VTMIS), to control their location and status, providing temporary or permanent marking of areas, dangerous for navigation, reliable and recognizable visualization onboard ships, equipped with modern integrated bridge navigation systems and operating in the areas concerned. The research carried out with the present work aims to highlight the problems and to propose acceptable solutions regarding the design and construction of coastal systems of aids to navigation in order to improve the safety of navigation. The present paper describes some ideas and experimental studies aimed to improve the buoyage system in Bulgarian territorial waters by integration of data from different sources, provided by Bulgaria VTMIS.

articleTitle: Investigation of an Unsymmetrically Loaded High Power Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A combination of many factors affect the operation of high-power synchronous generators, and hence the quality of the electrical energy they produce. One of them is the operation of the generator under unsymmetrical load, which, although inevitable, creates a number of problems both for the generator and for the consumers connected to it. From the various methods for studying an unsymmetrically loaded synchronous generator, an analysis based on the finite element method is selected in this paper. Three different modes of unsymmetrical loading are investigated and compared with those of a symmetrically loaded synchronous generator. The obtained results are evaluated and compared based on the harmonic composition of electromotive force and the amplitude of the individual harmonics. Another evaluation criterion is the shape and distortion of the electromagnetic field in the different modes.

articleTitle: Influence of the Oil Cooling on the Heating of an Oil-Immersed Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: One of the most important parameters for the normal operation of a transformer is its level of heating. Transformer heating significantly determines the reliability and service life of the transformer. The temperature distribution in the active parts of the transformer during its operation depends on the current load and the cooling conditions of the transformer. The influence of the cooling conditions on the heating of the transformer is investigated in this paper through a developed 3D computer model of an oil-immersed transformer. Results have been obtained on the effect of the oil velocity and oil temperature on the transformer thermal field.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of Cûk DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In the present paper, a harmonic analysis of a Cuk DC-DC converter is realized. A simulation model was implemented in MATLAB/Simulink. The converter is described using differential equations that are represented in state space. Two scenario of on and off transistor are considered. Simulation results are shown, where it can be observed in which case resonance occurs, which significantly influences the design of the circuit. Main advantages and disadvantages of the selected topology are described.

articleTitle: An Accelerated SFTessellation Algorithm for Obtaining a Voronoi Diagram
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper proposes an accelerated variant of an algorithm for obtaining a Voronoi diagram In the original version [1], the state of all elements of the discrete network was recalculated at each step, which even with not particularly large network sizes leads to a long time to obtain the final result. In the proposed variant, the state of only the elements adjacent to the wave fronts is recalculated, which repeatedly shortens the execution time.

articleTitle: Diffraction Model of Electromagnetic Wave
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper, a diffraction model of an electromagnetic wave passing by a car-shaped object is proposed and investigated. The diffraction model allows to generate diffraction patterns from different objects, at different wavelengths and at different distances from the object. The proposed model is based on the Fourier transform and can be used in various fields of science. In the present research, we use the model to study the forward scattering phenomenon that occurs in bistatic radar systems for the detection of moving objects.

articleTitle: Faults of the Electrical Equipment of Facilities Operating in Underground Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The requirements regarding the reliable operation, uninterruptibility and safety in exploitation of mine electrical equipment are much higher than the requirements that are placed on electrical equipment operating in other branches of industry. The report presents the results of a study of faults occurred in the electrical equipment of mining machinery operating in an underground mine for a period of one year.

articleTitle: Experimental Setup for Studying the Oscillations of Two Degrees of Freedom Spring Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Modern advances in microtechnology have facilitated the development of compact, cost-effective, integrated accelerometers and gyroscopes that are suitable for investigating the motion of various structures, mechanisms, and machines. This paper presents an experimental setup for performing experiments to record large oscillations of a spring system with two degrees of freedom. Two 3D accelerometer and 3D gyroscope modules, a low-cost microcontroller, and a wireless communication module are used. The experiments show that measurements that use integrated digital accelerometers to investigate the kinetics of such a class of mechanical systems allow for a significantly more comprehensive analysis of their behavior than traditional measurements.

Author Keywords: two degrees of freedom nonlinear oscillations

articleTitle: Influence of the Orientation of PV Installations Without Energy Storage on Their Operational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The problem for optimal orientation and inclination of PV modules can be considered completely solved when total annual generation is taken into account. The south orientation and optimal inclination angle, for a given location, are available and the adequacy of the data is statistically proven. Not optimal designs with East/West orientation of PV panels gain increasing popularity. The hourly distribution of the generated energy and significant variation of the electricity price encourages more and more users to prefer a non-canonical arrangement of the panels, which, however, equalizes as much as possible the load diagram of the generated energy. In the present work, a simulation study of the possible benefits of East/West orientation of photovoltaics is presented. Both, residential and commercial installations are considered. The generated energy is simulated and possible benefits are estimated. The profit (or loss) due to the electricity price variation is also studied. The possible match between the generation and load schedules in the case of residential load is shown. The cases when East/West orientation is beneficial compared to the optimal design are determined.

articleTitle: Condition of Electric Arc Quenching in an Arc Extinguishing Device
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical modeling of the process of electric arc quenching an in an arc extinguishing device. The calculation results are presented and the condition of electric arc quenching in the arc extinguishing device is formulated.

articleTitle: Sound-to-COLOR Smart Acoustic Device
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The article presents a device that automatically converts the frequency of sound waves into colors. To achieve this, a precise mathematical approach is applied. New software tools for realizing the procedures for analyzing and visualizing sound frequencies have been proposed. The aim of this work is to outline the possibility of using the proposed devise and adapted algorithms and procedures by hearing-impaired people.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Characretistics of a Lithium Ion and a Lithium Titanate Oxide Battery by Impedance Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Li-ion batteries are widely used in different types of energy storage systems as well as in the automotive industry. This paper studies possibility of using impedance spectroscopy for analyzing battery's state of health. In this work, the impedance characteristics of Li-ion and LTO batteries are compared. The comparisons are made for cells with different state of charge (SOC). Characteristics for series and parallel connected cells of a battery energy storage system are obtained.

articleTitle: Simulation Investigation of the Passive, Active, and Combined Filters
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper's authors focus on the simulation study and analysis of the passive, active, and combined noise reduction filters. The filters were synthesized in the Matlab/Simulink program environment. The power factor and the nonlinear distortions in the simulation models of a single-phase controllable rectifier circuit without filter and in a circuit with passive, active or combined filter are considered and analyzed.

articleTitle: FEM–Based Analysis of Induction Machine Broken Rotor Bar Detection Using Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an extended Kalman filter - based (EKF -based) detection method of broken bars in induction machine (IM). The objective is to detect the change in rotor resistance of a cage induction machine in case of one or more broken bars. To analyze the proposed fault detector, simulations are carried out. In the applied simulation environment, finite element method (FEM) model is used to describe the electric behavior of IM. The broken bars are modelled in the FEM simulations.

articleTitle: Evaluating Yolov5 Models on Thermal Imagery for Aerial Drone Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The fusion of thermal sensors with drone technology has ushered in significant advancements in various sectors, including environmental monitoring, search and rescue missions, and wildlife surveillance. The ability to detect objects effectively in thermal images is essential for the success of these applications. This research evaluates the effectiveness of YOLOv5 models in processing thermal imagery, with a focus on their processing speed, accuracy in detection, and the range of objects they can identify.

articleTitle: Modeling of Power Quality Disturbances Caused by EV Charging Stations with Integration of PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article proposes a model for assessing the impact of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations integrated with photovoltaic (PV) systems on power quality. The study aims to investigate the potential disturbances introduced by EV charging stations, particularly when combined with renewable energy sources like PV systems. The behavior of a power supply system with or without integrated PV installation can be modeled to assess the influence of inverter-based power supply on the power quality indicators. Simulation and analysis approach for transients and harmonic distortions caused by EV charging allows for studying the influence of PV integration on reducing these disturbances. The model allows the assessment of different electromagnetic disturbances under distinct system operating modes and load configurations.

articleTitle: Nano-technological Synthesis of Wollastonite for High-Efficiency Dry Pressing of Innovative Insulating Bodies for Low Voltage Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a dissertation work focusing on innovating the synthesis of wollastonite through sol-gel nanotechnology for ceramics used in low voltage apparatus. The research addresses the challenges faced by a Bulgarian producer, NIKDIM Ltd. Kazanlak, in manufacturing insulating bodies for low voltage fuses due to the scarcity and costliness of imported raw materials. The study explores alternative materials and innovative production methodologies to meet the increasing demand for low voltage fuses driven by renewable energy sources and electric vehicles. The synthesis process involves preparing solutions of CaO and TEOS, homogenising them, and mixing them with stabilisers to form a transparent sol, which gels at room temperature. The research methods employed include sol-gel synthesis, magnetic stirring, gelation, drying, crushing, thermal treatment, and ball milling, illustrating a comprehensive approach to materials research and development. The results show a synthesis of mono-phase Ca3(SiO3)3 at 1300°C marks a significant advancement in producing high-purity wollastonite materials, which ensures both the crystallinity and industrial applicability of the phase, highlighting the importance of precise temperature control in material preparation. The tests of pressed material confirmed that wollastonite is a superior material for low-voltage fuses, offering enhanced mechanical and thermal properties, greater strength, and lower energy consumption for firing compared to traditional steatite.

articleTitle: DC- DC Converter for Energy Storage System with Different Inductor Implementations
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents an evaluation of the operating modes of a DC/DC buck converter with various inductor configurations. Since real-world DC and AC losses can be limited by using various designs or configurations of switching inductors, a study is carried out to determine the losses and the influence on other parameters such the volume and mass constraints, cost and ease of implementation in order to obtain optimal design and parameters of the converter.

articleTitle: Generalized Net Model of DSP Real-Time Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Generalized nets are used in various fields for discrete event simulation and parallel processes flow representation. In this article is represented a generalized net model of circular addressing, double buffered DSP system, based on ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller architecture.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality in Support of the Learning Process
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper explores one of the options for supporting the learning process through the use of laboratory stands. The paper examines options for building control of electrical devices through mobile devices and providing specialized information to users. Cloud services were used for software provisioning, enabling easier project construction by staff whose competencies are more outside the realm of programming. The maximum distance from which the constructed control interface can be used is studied for various sizes of project launch markers. It has also been checked the influence of the light temperature in the room.

articleTitle: Apparatus Complex for Assessment of Athlet's Functional State Indicators Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Authors are raising the problem of the virtual trainers development for phygital sportsmen in this paper. Phygital sportsman is in a special functional state that can be observed using a brain-computer interface when he performs exercises. Neurocomputer interface can help to develop a recommending system for making a optimal training plan in conjunction with the virtual reality tracking accurately a human location in the digital environment. Authors describe a proposed complex and work principle of every single part of it. In the conclusion authors note these trainers will the irreplaceable tools in the development of phygital sportsman's skills.

articleTitle: Modelling of PV Plant for Supplying of Medium Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In current research a photovoltaic plant for supplying medium sized enterprises is studied. In the presented manuscript the main advantages of the proposed system and disadvantages of connecting photovoltaic systems to the distribution network are discussed. Also, the parameters and external influences on the power plant are presented. Data from smart meters for electricity production for a period of 1 year were used.

articleTitle: Procedure for Battery Module Assessment in Hybrid Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Electric and hybrid vehicles are becoming increasingly popular among environmentally conscious consumers, significantly impacting the automotive industry and the development of battery technologies. Fast diagnostic solutions are becoming critical as battery systems wear out over time and performance degrades. This study aims to investigate the battery system of a dedicated electric vehicle, the Toyota Prius, and its condition diagnostics. The test was performed by querying and saving the data using a custom Arduino-based specific measurement tool. The battery modules in the system were tested separately during the evaluation. During the condition assessment, the deviation from the average voltage of different sizes is analyzed and weighted individually depending on the size of the deviation. The analyses also cover more static and dynamic driving styles. The results show the influence of the driving style on the module voltage deviation. Furthermore, the method allows the detection and localization of weak battery modules in the system.

articleTitle: Audit of the Infrastructure as an Element of Cybersecurity of a Business Entity
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper has been made an attempt to systematize the tasks and activities related to the audit of the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Infrastructure of a business entity. The emphasis is on the risks that can arise from basic groups of possible problems. One of the goals of the final audit results and accompanying diagnostic analysis is to improve and enhance the Entity's Cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Phase Failures During Starting of High Power In-House Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The operation of sections of in-house loads and auxiliary equipment of a Bulgarian power station in fault conditions during starting procedures that take place after completion of planned annual repairment is studied. The considered fault conditions are single-phase open circuit, double-phase open circuit and single-phase open circuit with earth fault. During starting procedures sections are not fully loaded. Based on results it can be seen that imbalances caused by phase failures and open circuit faults during starting are practically similar as whenever they are fully loaded. Thus, the respective protection devices trip accordingly.

articleTitle: HBEM and Conformal Mapping Application for Characteristic Parameters Calculation of Two-Wire Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The object of this paper is the comparison of values of the capacitance per unit length and characteristic impedance of two-wire transmission lines obtained through the application of the conformal mapping method known as the Joukowsky transform and the hybrid boundary element method (HBEM). The numerical results are presented in tabular and graphical form.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of a Current Amplifier in Ultra Deep Sub-micron Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this paper a combination of graphical and theoretical approaches is described to design a MOSFET current amplifier in a deep sub-micron technology. This approach overcomes some challenges in the analog design with modern CMOS technologies, where short channel effects are significant. Simplified small signal model of the amplifier is developed and various approaches are proposed to derive the main circuit parameters. The accuracy of the parameter estimation for each approach is validated against Spectre simulation.

articleTitle: Algorithm Development Using Artificial Intelligence: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Recently Artificial Intelligence has been used in a great variety of practical fields. Machine learning is the leading approach to address problems. It provides means of solving problems that can hardly be formalized. Machine learning technologies such as deep neural networks are used to find new algorithms in various scientific fields, such as mathematics, computer sciences, medicine, among others. This paper provides a concise overview of recent trends and advancements in the development of algorithms facilitated by novel machine learning methodologies.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacturability Studies on Starting and Magnetic Locking Problems for Industrial Single-Phase Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this study, the parameters affecting the locked rotor and torque characteristics of the single-capacitor single phase induction motor were examined in detail during the design process. These parameters are critical factors that determine at what load and how long it takes for the motor to reach its nominal speed. An exemplary single-phase induction motor is designed based on specific requirements. An in-depth analysis was carried out on the effects of winding design and rotor skew, keeping the lamination geometry constant. Prototype motors were produced by making appropriate choices according to the findings obtained from the analysis results. In addition, the test results of the prototype motors were compared, which helped evaluate the accuracy and effectiveness of the work performed.

articleTitle: L1 Norm Minimization in ISAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This work deals with an ISAR (Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar) image enhancement algorithm using target's sparse image and image's <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{1}$</tex> norm minimization. As calculation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{1}$</tex> norm of two-dimensional (2D) image matrix is too complicated, target's image matrix is resized to one-dimensional (1D) one. According to ISAR theory, the ISAR signal matrix is a Fourier transform of the target's image matrix. Thus, the ISAR signal is obtained one dimensional one while modelling by Fourier transform of a certain target's image column matrix. In the image reconstruction algorithm, 12 norm constrained function and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{12}$</tex> objective function are defined. Simulation experimental results prove functionality of the developed algorithm.

Author Keywords: ISAR signal model based on Fourier decomposition

articleTitle: Drone Detection Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In recent years, the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) for both civilian and military purposes has significantly increased. The unlimited possibilities of their use in solving a wide range of tasks, including for entertainment, makes them very attractive to people. Their uncontrolled increase also leads to an increase in unwanted incidents with them. This necessitates the introduction of regulatory requirements for their use in combination with the use of technologies to control the areas of their use. To monitor and control drones, it is necessary to develop technologies for their detection, classification, tracking and eventual blocking. In this paper, an algorithm for drone detection through image processing is proposed and explored. The detection is carried out with a multi-channel algorithm, which allows to detect objects separated at different distances from the camera. Object recognition is done using the YOLO (You Only Look Once) program, which has difficulties detecting very small objects. The experiments were conducted on standard video images and on thermal images. The advantage of infrared or thermal imaging is that it can be applied in the dark part of the day.

articleTitle: Analyis of ZVS Converter for Energy Storage in PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper proposes a converter that can be used to retrofit existing photovoltaic (PV) systems with energy storage. The phase-shifted full bridge is considered for converting energy between the PV and a battery with power levels typical of personal system - up to 10kWp of solar power. The proposed circuit is analyzed with both simulation and experimental verification of the obtainable efficiency under different input voltages.

articleTitle: Generalized Nets for a Training Academy
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The current publication will present the process that was designed for creating and implementing a software training academy within a private company in Bulgaria. For the description of the process we used generalized nets.

articleTitle: Principles for Building Cyber Security in Information and SCADA Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: With the increase of new renewable electrical power plants being designed and constructed it is more common that the supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) is implemented via “TCP/IP” protocol, usually with the services of local internet suppliers. of all types of cybersecurity, the widespread SCADA protection methods is an additional “firewall” or using “VPN” services that allow only certain devices, or “parties”, to make changes in the output parameters of the power plants. in this article a different than the standard methods have been considered to provide an additional layer of protection to the already existing practices. the main idea is to analyze the contemporary cybersecurity solutions. based on the analytics propose a development of an algorithm that the information will be transmitted through separate channel owned by the user. thus, information security will be increased at the cost of speed. algorithm is tested in laboratory. perceived high accuracy of sent and received data provide a proof of its high reliability and effectiveness of it.

articleTitle: Electroosmotic Pump in Power Electronics Cooling Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of an electroosmotic pump in power electronics cooling systems. The use of an electroosmotic pump in cooling systems will increase the reliability of the cooling system due to the absence of movable elements subject to mechanical wear, and an increase in the efficiency of the electroosmotic pump is also expected compared with electromechanical pumps by reducing the chain of conversion of electrical energy into the energy of movement of the coolant. An overview of the state of research on electric osmosis in capillary structures and methods for modeling electroosmotic flow are presented. Publications on implemented electroosmotic pumps used in cooling systems are considered.

articleTitle: Proximity Sensor Based on Magnetoelectric Material
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of the physical foundations of the creation of proximity sensors that determine the movement of an object or the distance to an approaching object and the implementation of a proximity sensor based on the magnetoelectric effect. The developed device can measure permanent and alternating magnetic fields. To determine its capabilities and resolution, hysteresis characteristics were evaluated and measured. In addition to the theoretical description of the sensor operation, measurements were carried out. Proximity sensors detect the movement of an object or the distance to an approaching object. Magnetoelectric layered structures can be classified as multiferroid materials that combine two or more types of ordering, such as ferromagnetic and ferroelectric ordering. Magnetoelectric elements when exposed to an external magnetic field, it is advisable to use them as sensors for creating automation devices, robotics, security systems, medical equipment and automotive industry. Theoretical and practical data on the research of the proximity sensor based on the magnetoelectric effect will be presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Apparatus Complex For Monitoring During Phygital Training
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of developing virtual simulators for phygital athletes. The phygital athlete is in a special functional state, which can be observed using the brain-computer interface when he performs exercises. A neurocomputer interface can help develop a recommendation system for making an optimal training plan in combination with virtual reality that accurately tracks a person's location in a digital environment. The authors describe the proposed complex and the principle of operation of each of its individual parts. In conclusion, the authors note that these simulators will become indispensable tools in the development of physical skills of an athlete.

articleTitle: Illuminance Meters - Influence of the Battery Load on the Readings - Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents a detailed experimental study on the influence of the battery load of portable illuminance meters on their readings. Five different types of illuminance meters are tested at different voltage levels, including full battery 9 V and when the low battery sigh appears at the device's screen (this happens at different voltage levels - from 6V, down to 3V). Ten samples from each type of illuminance meter considered are tested and their illuminance readings are taken. The results obtained are representative and give information about the difference of the readings and the mistake made by people, using devices with low batteries for illuminance measurements.

Author Keywords: influence of battery level on readings

articleTitle: Optimisation of ML algorithm for SynRM fault detection
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper examines the possibility of machine learning AI integration in shipboard SynRM diagnostics. Data from simulations performed in Matlab are used to train the ML models. Optimization is performed by changing the reduction factor/measurement density to achieve optimal results in terms of accuracy or training time for one of the most commonly used classifiers.

articleTitle: LEDS -Non - Image Forming Effects and Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The current publication aims to bring clarity on the interconnection between the opportunity to achieve energy efficiency and simultaneously influence to the greatest possible extent the cyclic processes in the human body, that are dependent on light. To achieve the goal set, an experimental study on radiant emittance of different LED retrofit lamps as well as conventional light sources is made and their influence on the five types of photoreceptors in the human eye is estimated numerically.

Author Keywords: a-opic influence of retrofit LED lamps

articleTitle: Study and Simulation of Arc Breakdown in Low-Voltage Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This article analyzes the experimental data of an arc fault produced in a low-voltage network. It is shown that an arc fault shows itself in multiple increase of the even harmonics levels. The arc simulation was carried out in the Simintech program.

articleTitle: Model-Based Determination of the PV Panels Orientations for Maximum Energy Yield
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In this article, a study has been made related to the evaluation of the placement of a photovoltaic plant on a roof. Placement studies in two scenarios are presented. In the first case, the photovoltaic panels are located on an east-west oriented roof. In the second case, a south study is presented. The main advantages and disadvantages of each of them are described, in relation to a specific application, and shading from the presence of chimneys, antennas, etc. is also taken into account.

articleTitle: Study of a Remote Dynamic Control System for the Heat Supply of an Educational Building
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: A model is developed to study the effectiveness of a SCADA system implementation for WEB-based remote monitoring and control of thermal processes with the provision of remote dynamic adjustment of thermal processes as a function of attendance, nonattendance time, as well as holiday periods in a typical educational building. The applicability of the model to other educational buildings with similar construction and thermophysical characteristics is analyzed.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Switching and Performance Speeds of Microcontrollers Applicable in Electrotechnological Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The present paper examines the execution times of basic operations when working with Arduino microcontrollers. The intervals required for reading analog and digital inputs have been determined, as well as those needed for switching them in case they are defined as outputs. The execution times of individual program commands available for use with the Arduino platform have also been investigated.

articleTitle: Monitoring the Proper Curing of Photopolymer in 3D Printing with Electrical Impedance Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Additive manufacturing is beginning to play a key role in new approaches to component manufacturing. This includes “print-on-demand” 3D printing, which can partially replace traditional manufacturing processes when large numbers of parts are produced in advance. However, as the number of applications for additive manufacturing grows, so does the question of how to effectively control the quality of the output. If we focus solely on photopolymers and objects produced by this technology, questions arise about how to measure the consistent output of manufactured parts and how to properly set up the manufacturing and post-processing process. In this paper, we present new approaches to monitoring the degree of curing of photopolymers using the Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS). The EIS, which is widely used to measure carrier transfer and charge storage processes, appears to be the most appropriate tool due to its non-destructive nature on the object under investigation. The EIS, in the context of photopolymer Additive Manufacturing (AM), is a relatively novel area of research that explores the electrical behaviour of photopolymer resins during the printing process. The results could be used to fine-tune vat polymerization 3D printing and also to optimize curing time. The data could also be used to improve the energy and material efficiency.

articleTitle: Research of Cooled Element Overheating in Heat Pipes
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of overheating of the cooled element depending on the heat pipe material used in the cooling system and on the operating time. The analysis of the necessary conditions for the occurrence of convective motion and its interaction with energy exchange at the liquid-vapor interface in thermal capillary tubes was carried out. Two types of heat pipes have been investigated. A copper heat pipe with a powder wick and water as a working fluid, the other is an aluminum heat pipe with a wick in the form of curly grooves on the inner surface of the heat pipe using two types of working fluid, acetone and ammonia. Numerical modeling of the heat transfer capacity of the heat pipes under study was performed as part of the work.

articleTitle: Operation Mode of Converters with Energy Dosing Through an Inductive Element with Application in Wireless Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This report presents the results of a study on energy dosing converters utilizing an inductive element operating under three different modes: no-load mode, short-circuit mode, and nominal load mode. Based on the study, a mathematical model has been derived to facilitate the design of such types of converters. This model significantly reduces the development time for this type of inverters. Subsequently, their capabilities are investigated in a model of a wireless power charging.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Energy Usage for Agricartulal Building: A case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This paper presents a case study of a photovoltaic energy system for an agricultural building. The purpose of the case study is to provide technical measures to improve the energy consumption of the building, according to the technical specification and the current regulations. Agricultural production buildings are by and large used during daytime, where the solar energy will be used only for own consumption. An analysis of the energy consumption for the building is done and a daily assessment shows the optimal requirements for such systems. The obtained outcome can be used in the development self-sustaining power supply systems for different types of buildings, concepts for buildings with zero and almost zero energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Simple Method for Determining the Offset of Vector Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: In measuring technique, it is extremely important to eliminate offsets. A simple method for determining the vector field sensor offset is presented. The method involves discrete angular rotation of the sensor using a tool in the form of a regular polyhedron. By simply averaging the measured results, the offset of the sensor is determined.

articleTitle: Use of Energy Storage Systems in Electrical Distribution Networks - Review
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: Globally, in recent years, there has been considerable research and development for the design, manufacturing, and large-scale implementation of renewable energy sources (RES). This is in response to the alarming pollution of the environment - water, air, and soil, as a result of overusing traditional technologies for the production of electrical energy. Since RES are intermittent and their output is variable, it is necessary to use storage systems to harmonize/balance their participation in the electrical energy grid. This article presents a literature review of the main types of electrical energy storage devices and their application in power distribution networks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Student Engagement Through Gamified Learning in Moodle LMS
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper explores the instructional design frameworks of motivation and engagement, drawing on self-determination theory and the concept of flow. The practical application of these theories is demonstrated in a Moodle LMS in a blended classroom at Nikola Vaptsarov Naval Academy, showcasing how gamification can enhance the learning experience. The narrative of the hero's journey is employed as a representation of the student's educational path, illustrating the transformative potential of gamified learning. This paper presents an improved cycle process for student's growth. A comparative analysis of the stages of a student's learning growth underscores the significance of innovative educational strategies in fostering motivation, engagement, and academic success.

articleTitle: Multicriterial Quantitative Estimations for Evaluation of Scenarios for Development of the Bulgarian National Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The paper presents approaches and results for multicriterial quantitative estimations concerning the evaluation of selected scenarios for development of the Bulgarian national energy system based on application of three Multi-Criteria Decision-Making Methods (MCDM): Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), Preference Ranking Method for Enrichment Evaluation (PROMETHEE) II and Multi-Attribute Utility Theory (MAUT). Analyses and conclusions are provided.

articleTitle: Technical Means for Teaching “Computer Modelling and Information Technology” at Lower Secondary Education
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: This scientific article examines the importance of technological tools in teaching Computer Modeling and Information Technology in lower secondary education. The focus is on integrating popular platforms such as micro:bit, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi into the learning process. The article presents pedagogical approaches and methods that use these technologies to enrich the learning environment and support the development of computer modeling and information technologies in students at lower secondary education.

articleTitle: Quantum Computing Technology - A Brief Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The basic theoretical and practical aspects of quantum computing - cutting-edge and advanced technology for processing and communication are surveyed. The most important concepts from quantum mechanics harnessed for quantum computing are considered. Non-classical phenomena such as entanglement and quantum teleportation are encapsulated. Some of the most prevalent quantum computing hardware technologies are analyzed in their basic features. The advantages and drawbacks of each technology implementation are pointed out. The paper is a concise and compact summary of quantum computing technology. It is useful to students or specialists who seek to get started in the field of quantum information and computing.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2024 23rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies (SIELA)
abstract: The XXIII-rd International Symposium on Electrical Apparatus and Technologies SIELA 2024 was held in Bourgas, Bulgaria, from 12 to 15 June 2024.
